name: Applications of differentiation tangents and optimization

questions.q: What is the gradient of the tangent to the curve y = 3x³ - 4x² + 5x - 2 at the point where x = 1?
Find the x-coordinate of the stationary point of the curve y = x² - 6x + 9.
Determine the equation of the normal to the curve y = x² at the point (2, 4).
What is the nature of the stationary point of y = x³ at x = 0?
For the function f(x) = 2x³ - 9x² + 12x + 1, find the values of x for which the function is increasing.
Find the minimum value of the quadratic function y = x² - 4x + 7.
A particle moves in a straight line such that its displacement s meters from a fixed point at time t seconds is given by s = t³ - 6t² + 9t. Find the acceleration when t = 4 seconds.
Find the rate of change of the area of a circle with respect to its radius r when r = 5 cm.
What is the gradient of the normal to the curve y = 4√x at x = 4?
Find the x-coordinate of the local maximum of the function y = -x³ + 3x² + 9x - 5.
An open rectangular box with a square base is to be made from 100 cm² of material. What is the maximum volume of the box?
Find the second derivative of y = (2x - 1)⁴ at x = 1.
At what point on the curve y = x³ - 3x is the tangent parallel to the x-axis?
If the displacement of a body is given by s = t³ - 3t², find the time t when the velocity is zero (for t > 0).
Find the interval for which the curve y = 2x³ - 15x² + 36x is concave downwards.
The radius of a sphere is increasing at a rate of 2 cm/s. Find the rate of increase of its volume when the radius is 3 cm.
Find the equation of the tangent to the curve y = e²ˣ at the point where x = 0.
What is the maximum value of y = x - x² for real numbers x?
Find the value of x where the function f(x) = x³ - 12x has a point of inflection.

A ladder 10 meters long rests against a vertical wall. If the bottom of the ladder slides away from the wall at a rate of 1 m/s, how fast is the top sliding down the wall when the bottom is 6 meters from the wall?
Find the slope of the curve y = ln(3x) at x = 2.
Determine the x-coordinate of the stationary point for y = x × eˣ.
For the curve y = x⁴ - 4x³, find the x-coordinate of the stationary point that is a point of inflection.
If y = sin(2x), what is the value of d²y / dx² at x = π/4?
Find the acute angle that the tangent to the curve y = x² at the point (1, 1) makes with the positive x-axis.
What is the minimum product of two positive numbers whose sum is 20?
Find the gradient of the curve y = x³ - 3x² + 2x at its point of inflection.
A cylindrical can is to hold 1000 cm³ of liquid. Find the radius that minimizes the total surface area.
Find the x-coordinate of the point on the curve y = x² - 5x + 4 where the tangent is perpendicular to the line y = x.
If f(x) = x³ + ax² + b has a local extremum at x = -2 and x = 1, find the value of a.
Find the rate of change of the perimeter of a square when its side length is expanding at a rate of 3 cm/s.
Determine the value of constant k for which y = kx - ln(x) has a stationary point at x = 0.5.
Find the maximum velocity given displacement s = t³ - 6t² + 15t for t ≥ 0.
What is the equation of the tangent to y = x³ - 3x at the origin (0, 0)?
Find the smallest value of the function f(x) = x³ - 3x + 5 on the interval [0, 2].
If y = x² × ln(x), what is dy/dx when x = e?
Find the x-coordinate of the inflection point for y = 3x⁵ - 5x⁴.
A rectangular garden is to be fenced with 40 meters of wire. What is the maximum possible area of the garden?
Find the gradient of the curve y = tan(x) at x = π/4.
Determine the value of a such that the function f(x) = x³ + ax² + x has no stationary points.
